label: Canonical bag, full pipeline (steps 1-6), qt64 default configs
source: start_benchmark.sh on branch KITTI-canonical, commit cffd20d; hdmapping-lio from benchmark-HDMapping_LIO-to-HDMapping c63e6b0 (HDMapping 5d43160)
notes: First KITTI run on the canonical pipeline. Ground truth: KITTI odometry poses (Velodyne frame), time offset fitted to the IMU (+0.481 s after the bag's first scan; gyro z vs ground-truth yaw rate). All algorithms run with their QT64 (Oxford Spires) canonical defaults, except hdmapping-lio: HDMapping GUI preset 3 (< 30 km/h, open spaces) with skip_first_file = false (sensor_overrides.conf, hdl64); with HDMapping's default parameters it diverges on KITTI. Rings are estimated from elevation bins; point times assume the scan starts at the header stamp (KITTI stamps the forward-facing moment, so they are likely ~50 ms late); KITTI scans may already be deskewed; the canonical bag is re-sliced to 100 ms (1156 clouds vs 1111 scans). APE is aligned at the first pose (evo --align_origin). pv-lio crashed at playback start (no result). lego-loam recorded only 287 poses. voxel-map trajectory did not move (fallback alignment). LOAM-Livox skipped (needs Livox input).
